SCAP1.label: Author Profile Correction

SCAP1.1.label: Documents Missing from Profile
SCAP1.1.description: Definition: Documents authored by the user have not been assigned to their author profile (e.g. indexed under a different profile or name variant).

SCAP1.2.label: Profile Not Found / Not Created
SCAP1.2.description: Definition: No author profile exists or it cannot be found, e.g. no indexed documents, a name variation, or a profile not yet created.

SCAP1.3.label: Profile Linked to Wrong Account
SCAP1.3.description: Definition: The Elsevier/Scopus account is associated with the wrong author profile.

SCAP1.4.label: Affiliation Incorrect / Outdated
SCAP1.4.description: Definition: The profile shows an incorrect or outdated affiliation because the affiliation data has not been updated.

SCAP1.5.label: Duplicate Profiles (Merge Needed)
SCAP1.5.description: Definition: The author's documents are split across multiple profiles that need to be merged.

SCAP1.6.label: Author Name Variant / Name Change
SCAP1.6.description: Definition: The author's name changed or appears in different forms, so documents or profile details do not match.

SCAP1.7.label: Profile Data / Metrics Incorrect
SCAP1.7.description: Definition: Profile details or metrics (e.g. h-index, document counts) show incorrect values.

SCAP1.8.label: Another Author's Documents in Profile
SCAP1.8.description: Definition: Documents by a different author have been wrongly attributed to the profile.

SCAP1.9.label: Profile Deletion / Opt-out
SCAP1.9.description: Definition: The author wants their profile removed or opted out.

SCAP1.10.label: Unknown / Not Stated
SCAP1.10.description: Definition: The conversation does not make clear what caused the profile problem.

SCAP1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified at Level 1 as 'Author Profile Correction'. Choose the Level 2 value from this group only. 'Author Profile Correction' means: Definition: Merge/split profiles, missing or wrong documents, name or affiliation fixes, profile not found/created, wrong profile linked — for a customer who can use Scopus. Rule 1 applies.
